file_level.name: quality
file_level.label: Quality
file_level.description: Defines overall animation fidelity and usability.

items.name: source
items.label: Source
items.description: Identifies the origin animation or dataset.

items.name: style
items.label: Style
items.description: The physical demeanor or emotional overlay that applies to the overall animation.

file_level.name: context
file_level.label: Context
file_level.placeholder: e.g. character exits through a heavy doorway
file_level.description: Optional sentence describing the overall scene or situation.

items.name: clipped
items.label: Clipped
items.description: True when this sequence was extracted from a longer take.

items.name: annotated
items.label: Annotated
items.description: True when frame-range metadata is verified.

items.name: commercial_use
items.label: Commercial Use
items.description: True when this file is cleared for commercial use.

items.name: state
items.label: State
items.description: The core locomotion or foundational action.

items.name: override_style
items.label: Override Style
items.description: Optional style that applies only to this range when it differs materially from the file style.

items.name: interaction_type
items.label: Interaction Type
items.description: The primary interaction performed in this range. 'sustain' means maintaining an ongoing interaction while waiting.

items.name: interaction_scope
items.label: Interaction Scope
items.description: The body parts actively constrained by the interaction.

frame_range.name: interaction_volumes
frame_range.label: Interaction Volumes
frame_range.description: Comma-separated scene nodes representing interaction volumes.

items.name: interaction_item
items.label: Interaction Item
items.description: Prop or target involved when no interaction volume exists.

items.name: contact_attributes
items.label: Contact Attributes
items.description: Comma-separated scene object attributes used to identify contacts. Enter each as object.attribute.

frame_range.name: events
frame_range.label: Events
frame_range.description: JSON dictionary mapping animation events to frame numbers.
